subject: DataSurge service continuity & renewal discussion
messages:
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria@datasurge.com>
To: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-03-01T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Upcoming license renewal + new rate card

Hi Ben,

Quick heads-up: your annual license with DataSurge is coming up for renewal on 2026-04-15. We've attached the updated rate card (2026_rate_card_v2.pdf) and the proposed 12-month term order summary. The new pricing increases reflect expanded enrichment throughput and higher QA SLAs we've rolled into our platform.

High-level changes:
- Base per-record price: $0.012 -> $0.014
- Deduped batch rates for >1M records reduced by 6% (new tier)
- New "priority ingestion" add-on: $1,200/month

If you want to lock current pricing we can extend your existing agreement for 3 months while we finalize terms; otherwise the new pricing would take effect on renewal. Happy to set up a call this week to walk the team through details.

Thanks,
Maria Gonzalez
Enterprise Renewals
DataSurge Analytics
Attachments: 2026_rate_card_v2.pdf

From: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-03-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Upcoming license renewal + new rate card

Forwarding DataSurge's renewal notice. TL;DR: price bump and a new add-on. Can procurement validate whether we should:

1) Accept a 3-month bridge extension to avoid new pricing while we decide, or
2) Push back and ask for a renewal concession tied to a 12-month commit (we could ask for a discount or SOW for reduced inventory).

Also: please pull last quarter usage (attached) so we have leverage.

Ben
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: usage_report_Q1_2026.csv

From: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
To: Maria Gonzalez <renewals@datasurge.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com, evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-03-02T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming license renewal + new rate card

Hi Maria,

Thanks for the notice. A few procurement questions before we move forward:

- Can you share your latest SOC 2 Type II report or a redacted copy (we require it for renewals)?
- Is the priority ingestion add-on mandatory for existing customers using bulk enrichment pipelines? If so, please provide technical docs.
- If we agree to a 12-month renewal, what discount tiers are available at our current usage (avg ~1.1M records/month)?
- Please confirm data retention and deletion guarantees (we need 90-day SLA for deletion requests).

If you can send the SOC2 and a proposed SOW/contract mark-up we can expedite.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Maria Gonzalez <maria@datasurge.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: renewals@datasurge.com
Date: 2026-03-03T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming license renewal + new rate card

Hi Lauren — appreciate the detailed questions.

- SOC 2 Type II: attached (SOC2_Type_2_redacted.pdf) and hosted link for full report (we can NDA the full).
- Priority ingestion add-on: optional; it's aimed at teams needing guaranteed processing windows. We can scope it out separately.
- Discount: we can offer a 10% renewal discount on the new rate if you commit to 12 months and accept electronic signature by 2026-03-12.
- Data deletion: we support API-driven deletion with a 72-hour confirmation window and 90-day secure purge.

I'll also upload a draft SOW to DocuSign if you'd like to run internal approvals quickly: https://app.docusign.com/ENVELOPEID/abcd-1234

If you'd like, we can also extend the current pricing for a 3-month continuity amendment while the SOW is agreed.

Cheers,
Maria Gonzalez
Enterprise Renewals, DataSurge
Attachments: SOC2_Type_2_redacted.pdf

From: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria@datasurge.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com, evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-03-05T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming license renewal + new rate card

Maria — thanks for the quick turn. Internal notes / ask:

- Procurement confirms SOC2 receipt and data-deletion terms look acceptable.
- Usage profile: ~1.1M records/month; peak spikes account for ~18% of monthly volume.

We have two asks before signing:
1) Can DataSurge reduce the proposed increase so net effective price change is <= +5% (we'd accept ~8% if needed) rather than the full bump? An 8% uplift + a guaranteed 12-month term would be acceptable to leadership.
2) For continuity, please issue a 3-month amendment to keep current pricing active while legal/procurement and your team finalize the SOW. That would prevent disruption to scheduled enrichment jobs.

If you can update the DocuSign with the 3-month continuity amendment and a 12-month SOW option that reflects the revised pricing (8% uplift on current tiers), we'll route for exec approval this week. Otherwise we'll move to the bridge extension and revisit pricing at renewal.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192
